links.why: Direction is reversed: the question 'what shall we say?' is what the condition conditions, so the link runs from cl0 to cl1.
The participle is not joined by 'and' to the question; it describes God in cl2.
The question (consequent) is conditioned by the if-clause cl1, 'our unrighteousness shows God's righteousness'.
ὁ ἐπιφέρων τὴν ὀργήν is a bare participle with no conjunction, agreeing with ὁ θεός of cl2; it describes God as the one who inflicts wrath.
'What shall we say?' (ἐροῦμεν) introduces the proposition 'God is unjust?' (cl2), which is its content (R1).

groups.why: The condition is cl1 and the consequence the question in cl0; the builder's grouping is right, only the link direction was wrong.

none_fit.where: cl4 (κατὰ ἄνθρωπον λέγω, 'I speak in human terms')
none_fit.what: A parenthetical disclaimer about the manner of the argument; no link type relates a comment on one's own argument. Left unlinked.

cant_tell.why: A verse-opening 'but' has no host in its own verse, so no contrast with 3:4 is drawn.
A turn needs a sender from the candidates; the speaker 'we' is not offered, so no turn is built.
